body.zh-Hant: 據德國國家圖書館規範檔（GND），曼努埃爾·貢德拉生於1871年1月1日的布宜諾斯艾利斯，卒於1927年3月8日的亞松森，父親是阿根廷人，母親是巴拉圭人。亞松森市政府的街名史頁面說，他先在比耶塔求學，其後以寄宿生身分就讀亞松森國立中學（Colegio Nacional）；中學於1900年結束後進入法學院，但因1904年革命（他曾參與）而未能完成學業，也沒有取得大學學位。
body.en: According to the GND authority record, Manuel Gondra was born on 1 January 1871 in Buenos Aires and died on 8 March 1927 in Asunción; his father was Argentine and his mother Paraguayan. The Asunción municipal page on the street named after him says he studied first at Villeta and then as a boarder at the Colegio Nacional in Asunción; after finishing secondary school in 1900 he entered the law faculty, but the 1904 revolution, in which he took part, left his studies incomplete and he earned no university degree.

citations.quote: Geburtsort: Buenos Aires
Sterbeort: Asunción
Vater arg., Mutter parag.
realizó sus primeros estudios en Villeta
después en el Colegio Nacional de Asunción como pupilo
Terminó la secundaria en el año 1900
la carrera quedó trunca debido a la Revolución de 1904, en la que participó
Sin llegar a obtener título universitario

heading.zh-Hant: 教育改革、外交與早期公職
heading.en: Education, diplomacy and early public service

body.zh-Hant: 《拉丁美洲歷史與文化百科》（具名作者 Daniel M. Masterson）稱，貢德拉後來在國立中學以成效卓著的教育改革者聞名，1902年進入公職，並在1905至1908年出任巴拉圭駐巴西公使。亞松森市政府頁面補充，他是教師、記者、外交官、歷史學者與散文家，1903年受總統埃斯庫拉委託處理巴拉圭對《彼得羅波利斯條約》的保留聲明。同一條目另說他曾任戰爭部長，整編陸軍並釐清查科地區的主權主張，但未給明確年份。
body.en: The Encyclopedia of Latin American History and Culture (signed by Daniel M. Masterson) says Gondra later built a reputation at the Colegio Nacional as a highly effective educational reformer, entered public life in 1902, and served as Paraguay's minister to Brazil in 1905–1908. The Asunción municipal page adds that he was a teacher, journalist, diplomat, historian and essayist, and that in 1903 President Escurra entrusted him with Paraguay's reservation to the Treaty of Petrópolis. The same entry also says he served as minister of war, reorganizing the army and clarifying Paraguay's legal claim to the Chaco, but gives no years.

citations.quote: Gondra later built a reputation as a highly effective educational reformer
Entering public life in 1902
he served as Paraguay's minister to Brazil (1905–1908)
Fue docente, periodista, diplomático, historiador, ensayista
En 1903 el presidente Juan Antonio Escurra le encomendó la
Resalva Paraguaya al Tratado de Petrópolis
Gondra served as minister of war, reorganizing Paraguay's army
clarifying his nation's legal claim to the disputed Chaco region

body.zh-Hant: 亞松森市政府頁面記載，貢德拉第一次任總統為1910年11月25日至1911年1月17日，只有51天；第二次自1920年8月15日起，至1921年11月7日止。該頁說他被迫在就任後不久辭職，對手是自己所屬自由黨內的首領們；《百科》也寫他第二次任內捲入內亂，僅十五個月就辭職。這兩段總統任期已在名單5442的任期紀錄中，此處只作背景敘述。
body.en: The Asunción municipal page records Gondra's first presidency as 25 November 1910 to 17 January 1911, only 51 days, and his second from 15 August 1920 to 7 November 1921. It says he was forced to resign soon after taking office, with caudillos of his own Liberal Party as his enemies; the encyclopedia entry likewise says civil strife again overtook him and he resigned after only fifteen months. Both presidencies are already in the list's 5442 term records, so they are background only here.

citations.quote: del 25 de noviembre de 1910 al 17 de enero de 1911
duró 51 días al frente de la Nación
desde el 15 de agosto de 1920 hasta el 7 de noviembre de 1921
obligado a renunciar a días de haber asumido
enemigos a caudillos de su propio partido político, el Liberal
He fell victim to civil strife once again
resigned his office after only fifteen months

body.zh-Hant: 《百科》指出，貢德拉因在1923年智利聖地牙哥第五屆美洲國家國際會議上倡議防止美洲國家間戰爭的條約而獲最高榮譽；亞松森市政府頁面說該會議因此被稱為「貢德拉公約」。《百科》又稱他藏有南美洲最好的圖書館之一，後來歸德州大學收藏。GND 與市政府頁面都記他逝於1927年3月8日。
body.en: The encyclopedia entry says Gondra earned his greatest recognition for sponsoring a treaty to prevent war among the American states at the Fifth International Conference of American States at Santiago, Chile, in 1923; the municipal page says that conference is remembered as the Gondra Convention. The entry adds that he owned one of the finest libraries in South America, now at the University of Texas. Both the GND record and the municipal page give his death as 8 March 1927.

body.zh-Hant: 芬蘭國家圖書館規範檔（GND）記載，尤霍·蘇尼拉生於1875年8月16日的利明卡，卒於1936年10月2日的赫爾辛基。學者拉塔拉（Tuomas Rantala）的文章說他出身當地望族，1895年通過大學入學資格考試後回家經營農場，後入穆斯蒂亞拉農業學校，畢業成為農藝師，1898年被聘為屈門拉克索民眾學院教師，1904年4月取得哲學候補博士（相當於碩士）學位。
body.en: The GND authority record gives Juho Sunila's birth as 16 August 1875 in Liminka and his death as 2 October 1936 in Helsinki. Tuomas Rantala's article says he came from a locally prominent family, passed the matriculation examination in 1895 and then farmed the family holding, later studied at the Mustiala agricultural school and qualified as an agronomist, was chosen in 1898 as a teacher at the Kymenlaakso folk high school, and in April 1904 completed the degree of filosofian kandidaatti (comparable to a master's).

heading.zh-Hant: 農業學者與農業行政官員

body.zh-Hant: 拉塔拉的文章記載，蘇尼拉1904年被選為哈梅省農業協會的秘書兼顧問，1907年秋以農田耕作制度為題進行博士答辯，1908年取得博士學位；1912年轉任農業協會中央聯盟，後來進入農業管理局成為國家公務員，並領導其農業經濟研究處。1923年冬，他的公職生涯以出任農業管理局總局長達到高峰。
body.en: Rantala's article records that in 1904 Sunila was chosen as secretary and consultant of the Häme provincial agricultural society, defended his doctoral thesis on field-farming systems in autumn 1907 and received the doctorate in 1908; he moved in 1912 to the Central Union of Agricultural Societies and later to the Board of Agriculture as a state official, heading its agricultural-economics research department. His civil-service career peaked in winter 1923 with his appointment as director general of the Board of Agriculture.

heading.zh-Hant: 國會、農業部長與兩度組閣
heading.en: Parliament, agriculture minister and two governments

body.zh-Hant: 依拉塔拉的文章，蘇尼拉應南哈梅農民聯盟（Maalaisliitto）人士之請，於1922年參選國會，並選擇該黨，當選後同年入閣出任農業部長。1927年12月他被任命為總理，組成農民聯盟少數政府；1929年他再度進入國會，1931年3月第二次出任總理，這次是資產階級聯合政府。1933年他因病未再參選，退出政壇。
body.en: According to Rantala, Sunila stood for parliament in 1922 at the request of Maalaisliitto (Agrarian League) members in southern Häme, chose that party, was elected and in the same year joined the cabinet as agriculture minister. In December 1927 he was appointed prime minister and formed a Maalaisliitto minority government; in 1929 he returned to parliament, and in March 1931 became prime minister a second time, now heading a bourgeois coalition. Ill health kept him from standing in 1933 and he left politics.

body.zh-Hant: 土庫大學的博士論文新聞稿說，蘇尼拉兩度任總理，被視為農民聯盟的思想導師之一；論文主張他在第二次任總理期間堅決捍衛民主，對抗拉普阿運動等議會外力量，並傾向與社會民主黨合作。拉塔拉在文章中也寫到，這屆政府因利率管制案未獲通過而總辭。
body.en: The University of Turku's press release on Rantala's doctoral thesis says Sunila served twice as prime minister and is counted among the ideological founders of the Agrarian League; the thesis argues that in his second premiership he defended democracy without compromise against extra-parliamentary forces such as the Lapua Movement, and sought cooperation with the Social Democrats. Rantala's article adds that the government resigned when its interest-rate regulation proposal failed to pass.

people.name: José Bordas Valdés
people.nameZh: 何塞·博爾達斯·巴爾德斯

body.zh-Hant: 美國駐聖多明各公使薩利文（James M. Sullivan）1914年4月17日的公文寫道，博達斯於1913年4月13日被選出，任期一年，期間須召集選舉產生繼任者。他在1914年3月15日的另一電報中說，國會曾以決議宣告選出博達斯，而卡塞雷斯總統任期的實際屆滿日是6月30日，並非4月13日。1914年6月1日美國國務卿的訓令則稱他為多明尼加共和國臨時總統何塞·博達斯·巴爾德斯將軍。
body.en: A dispatch of 17 April 1914 from the US minister in Santo Domingo, James M. Sullivan, says Bordas was elected on 13 April 1913 for a term of one year, within which he was to call an election for a successor. In a telegram of 15 March 1914 Sullivan wrote that a congressional decree had pronounced the choice of Bordas, and that the real end of President Cáceres's term was 30 June rather than 13 April. The US Secretary of State's instruction of 1 June 1914 calls him the Provisional President of the Dominican Republic, General José Bordas Valdés.

citations.quote: American Legation Santo Domingo , April 17, 1914
James M. Sullivan
On April 13, 1913, Bordas was elected for the term of one year
within which period he should call for the election of a successor
congressional decree which pronounced choice of Bordas
election of president to succeed Bordas on June 30th
the real date when the Caceres term ended, instead of April 13th
the Provisional President of the Dominican Republic, General Jose Bordas Valdes

body.zh-Hant: 薩利文1914年2月5日電報稱，執政黨內部分裂，他設法阻止了對博達斯的彈劾。3月4日他說服博達斯向阿里亞斯（Arias）作最後呼籲；3月19日又報告博達斯已公布4月1日與2日為總統與國會選舉日。4月17日的公文說，阿里亞斯在西巴奧（Cibao）發動叛亂，博達斯親率一千五百人出征。
body.en: Sullivan's telegram of 5 February 1914 says the government party was divided and that he had succeeded in preventing the impeachment of Bordas. On 4 March he reported persuading President Bordas to make a last appeal to Arias, and on 19 March that Bordas had published 1 and 2 April as election days for the presidency and the lower house. His dispatch of 17 April says Arias was leading an insurrection in the Cibao and that Bordas had taken the field against him with 1,500 men.

citations.quote: Government party is divided
I succeeded in preventing impeachment of Bordas
Have persuaded President Bordas to make last appeal to Arias
Bordas has published April 1 and 2 as election days for Presidency
The Government is being opposed by Arias, leading an insurrection in the Cibao
Bordas has taken the field against Arias with a force of 1,500 men

body.zh-Hant: 1914年6月1日，美國國務卿依博達斯的建議，指定約翰斯頓（Charles M. Johnston）出任多明尼加財政專家，行使審計長式的權限。同年8月，威爾遜總統向美方委員交付的計畫要求各方公推一位臨時總統，並明言博達斯將放棄其現有職位與權力。美國《外交關係》1914年卷的章名則直接標示「臨時總統博達斯去職」。去職日期見名單5442的任期紀錄。
body.en: On 1 June 1914 the US Secretary of State, acting on Bordas's own suggestion, designated Charles M. Johnston as Financial Expert to the Dominican Republic, with comptroller-type powers. In August 1914 President Wilson's plan, handed to the US commissioners, called for the parties to agree on a provisional president and stated that Bordas would relinquish his position and authority. The 1914 volume of Foreign Relations of the United States labels the chapter with the resignation of Provisional President Bordas. His exact resignation date is in the list's 5442 term record.

citations.quote: The Secretary of State to Mr. Charles M. Johnston
In accordance with the suggestion of His Excellency
to assume the duties of Financial Expert to the Dominican Republic
under date of May 26, 1914
you have been designated by the President of the United States
To exercise all the powers of a Comptroller over the Receivership
Plan of President Wilson , handed to Commissioners Fort and Smith , August, 1914
act as Provisional President of the Republic
Mr. Bordas will relinquish his present position and authority
resignation of Provisional President José Bordas Valdés
